question: Does the Deribit implied volatility regime (DVOL) at the touch judge whether the BTC/ETH Monday 1618 holds?
primary_hypothesis: Lower dvol_pct90 (calm implied-vol regime) -> higher validity: earlier AUC of -dvol_pct90 >0.5 and later one-sided permutation p<0.01.
success_criterion: Model on dvol_pct90, dvol, dvol_chg_24h, rv_iv trained before split: later AUC>=0.55, early-threshold top30 percent validity>=38.2 and mean R>0, week-stratified p<0.01.
limitations: Only BTC and ETH; DVOL hourly with one-bar lag; Binance 15m conservative labels; fee 0.
